messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@acmeinc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up & MAP request after today's demo

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. The team found the latency/cost breakdown helpful and we want to move a MAP-style plan forward so procurement and engineering are aligned. A few quick asks from our side:

- Can you send a short MAP draft with milestones, owners, and major dependencies (SSO, SOC2 evidence, pilot dataset access)?
- We are aiming to pilot the integration in July; procurement has asked if signature can be completed by mid-June so we can start on-boarding the week of 6/23. Is that feasible on your side?
- I will loop in procurement separately but our procurement lead is Linda Rao (procurement@acmeinc.com). If you need a formal PO timeline, please include it in the MAP.

Appreciate a concise version we can share with stakeholders.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Li
Director, Product Integrations
Acme Instruments
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-23T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & MAP request after today's demo
Attachments: redwood_map_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP (redwood_map_v1.xlsx) targeted to your July pilot. High-level items below; see attachment for row-level milestones.

Proposed high-level timeline (target close):
- Target contract signature: 2025-06-20 (goal for internal planning)
- Procurement / contract signature deadline (hard checkpoint): 2025-06-12 — aim to have PO issued by 2025-06-05 so legal and finance have runway.

Milestones & primary owners (summary):
- Finalize SOW & pricing (Owner: Redwood - Jordan / Legal: Ben Carter) — dependent on legal review; DocuSign flow planned.
- SOC2 evidence handoff (Owner: Acme - Hannah / Redwood: Security contact) — dependency for enterprise procurement review.
- SSO / SAML integration (Owner: Acme eng / Redwood eng - Camila) — estimated 3 weeks of integration + test window.
- Pilot dataset ingestion & validation (Owner: Acme / Redwood support) — needs sample data and test credentials.
- Platform onboarding & runbook (Owner: Redwood CSM - Camila) — runbook delivered one week before pilot.

Key dependencies called out in the attachment: SOC2 report, procurement PO timeline, internal security scanning window, and customer test data.

Questions for you: can you confirm Linda Rao as procurement point and whether 6/12 is acceptable as the signature cutoff? If procurement requires earlier legal review, we can slide the contract approval target earlier — calling out tradeoffs in the MAP.

If that looks ok I'll update the sheet with the exact contacts and send a DocuSign link for the SOW once we align on milestone owners.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@acmeinc.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-24T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up & MAP request after today's demo

Adding a couple practical notes from an implementation perspective — I pulled the MAP and put inline comments in the spreadsheet, but summary here: 

- SSO/SAML: plan on a three-week integration window + one week of test sign-ons. Recommend we schedule the initial SSO kickoff within a week of signature.
- SOC2 evidence: procurement will expect a short SOC2 summary + point of contact for audit questions; we can provide a redacted SOC2 summary and SOC2 contact (security@redwood.ai). This is typically enough for initial procurement review; full report can be produced under NDA if needed.
- Pilot data: we'll need a sanitized sample dataset & schema by the end of June to validate ingestion before the July pilot.
- Milestone order: suggest moving SSO ahead of the pilot ingestion step to avoid blocking the pilot start.

Small ask: given internal legal review cycles at Acme, a signature cutoff of 2025-06-15 would be safer if their legal requires two review passes — otherwise we risk slipping pilot by 2–3 weeks. If Procurement can commit to PO by 6/5 we can stick with 6/12 cutoff.

Camila
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

Hannah — quick legal/finance notes from Redwood's side: 

- DocuSign & SOW: We typically run the SOW in DocuSign with a single SOW+MSA flow. If Acme requires redlines, please flag them early; two rounds of redlines + internal approval usually takes ~10 business days.
- PO path: If Acme issues a PO referencing the agreed SOW and pricing, our finance team can accept the PO and expedite onboarding. If PO will be delayed, we can provision temporary access under a trial agreement but won't start paid onboarding until PO is received.
- SOC2: We can provide the SOC2 Type II summary and the SOC2 auditor contact under an NDA. For procurement reviews we often attach the SOC2 summary and key control list — that generally satisfies initial procurement.

Operational ask: please provide the procurement contact and expected PO issuance date so we can set internal provisioning gates. To meet a 2025-06-12 signature cutoff without risk, we need: PO by 2025-06-05 OR signed SOW by 2025-06-12 with procurement confirming funding.

Ben Carter
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
